votes.motion: Approve the requested variance for the septic system at the site presented by Steve Marsden (groundwater offset from four feet to three feet).
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by jewell and second by passios, the requested variance was approved.

votes.motion: Approve the requested variance in offset to groundwater from five feet to four feet at 18 Crescent Road.
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by jewell and second by auge, the request was all in favor.

votes.motion: Approve the request to allow the two wells at 225 Elmwood Road to continue in use as irrigation wells.
votes.quote: on motion by auge and second by passios, the request was approved.

votes.motion: Approve the variances for 97 Rolling Acres Road (groundwater offset from four feet to three feet).
votes.quote: on motion by jewell and second by auge, the variances were approved.

votes.motion: Approve the variance for 1596 Massachusetts Avenue (groundwater offset from five feet to four feet).
votes.quote: on motion by jewell and second by fortin, the variance was approved.

votes.motion: Approve the variance for 1134 Northfield Road on the condition that there be an Article at Town Meeting allowing the easement for this property.
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by auge and second by passios, the variance was approved with the condition

votes.motion: Approve the variances for 1396 Massachusetts Avenue (groundwater offset from five feet to four feet and reduction in inlet and outlet tee distance).
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by jewell and second by auge, the variances were approved.

decisions.decision: The Board agreed to add language to the septic loan application forms stating that loan funds may be used to connect to public sewer for a failed septic system, but not to pay betterment fees.
decisions.quote: after discussion, the board agreed to add the language to the application forms to clearly state that funds from this loan program could be used to connect to public sewer for a failed septic system.

decisions.decision: After discussion the Board approved the Septic System Loan Program application due and decision dates of March 1, 2016 and April 1, 2016 (no motion recorded).
decisions.quote: after discussion the board approved the following: applications due: decisions: march 1, 2016 april 1, 2016
